hero_title: Intensive French immersion courses for adults

intro_title: Learn together in a friendly atmosphere
feature_city: A medieval chateau and narrow lanes filled with bars, restaurants, cafes, boutiques and craft shops. The train station is just a few minutes’ walk from the classroom so there’s no need for a car during your stay.
feature_for_you: morning language-based activities, lunches at a restaurant in town and afternoon visits to local places of interest.
un_accueil_lcoute: Language training tailored to your needs
feature_welcome: You’ll find a warm welcome, guidance and support in a peaceful relaxed atmosphere.
photo_mountains_alt: View of the Pyrenees from Foix
testimonial_1: “Celine is an excellent teacher.  She genuinely wants to help you learn to speak French, and uses conversations to discuss and learn words, sentence construction and grammar geared to your level of French.  Her patience is amazing.”-- Kristin  from New Zealand
testimonial_2: “Celine is an excellent teacher.  She allows you to drive the direction of the lesson by raising topics of interest to you, and building her lesson around these topics.  She also encourages you to attend events in Foix that could help your French. I highly recommend her classes as an effective and fun way to progress your French.”-- Julian from New Zeeland.

les_stages_et_cours_intensifs_foix_lingu: Intensive courses and programmes - Foix Lingua
courses_intro: 30 h per week: classes, lunches, outings, and cultural workshops.
courses_collective_subtitle: Training based on well-being and kindness
formation_french_immersion: The training is designed to provide a 'French bath', 30 hours per week.
fun_practical_classes: Engaging, hands-on learning using authentic materials, with a focus on speaking and backed up by clear grammar explanations.
convivial_lunches: Lunches in Foix are an ideal time for teacher-guided conversation. Sometimes my friends come along so you can hear different accents and viewpoints. (Dietary requirements are catered for).
real_situation_outings: Visits to local places of interest are an opportunity to speak in real-life situations as well as discovering the city and the Occitanie region.
activits_autour_de_la_culture_locale_cou: Activities centred on local culture: cooking classes, tastings of local products, ‘aperitif’ concerts, farm visits, workshops etc.
groupes_de_maximum_six_tudiants_de_nivea: Groups of max. 6 students of a similar level. Let me know if you wish to attend as a group or with mixed levels.
si_un_seul_tudiant_est_prsent_une_semain: If there is only one student for a week, the course will still take place at the same price, but with 25 hours of classes instead of 30.
cours_individuels_suivant: Individual classes according to group organization
courses_individual_subtitle: Designed for your personal goals and objectives.
courses_individual_intro: Each lesson follows a tried and tested teaching method and is tailored to your specific needs.
courses_individual_step_a: A listening or written text is used to introduce target vocabulary and grammar points.
courses_individual_step_b: Role-playing exercises for developing vocabulary and grammar skills.
courses_individual_step_c: A written summary to reinforce your learning.
courses_individual_step_d: Homework exercises for the next class, designed to help you consolidate what you have learnt.
courses_individual_modalites_schedule: A timetable is worked out together based on your availability and goals.
15_heures_de_cours_particuliers_par_sema: 15 hours of private lessons per week, plus optional activities and visits, with full-board accommodation.
la_chambre_ltage_de_ma_ma_maison_foix_es: The room has its own private bathroom and toilet and is on the first floor of my house. You are welcome to sit out in the garden and even help me to do the gardening!
levels_intro: Discover the profiles corresponding to each level.
levels_info_text: At FOIX LINGUA, there is only a small group of up to 6 students maximum at a time. Classes are open to all levels. The level of the first person to register determines the level of the week.
levels_calendar_text: The calendar shows the dates corresponding to each level.
levels_cefr_description: The levels correspond to the following profiles. The indications in parentheses (A2, B1, etc.) refer to the CEFR levels (Common European Framework of Reference for Languages — see the grid: https://europass.cedefop.europa.eu/fr/resources/european-language-levels-cefr).
profile_a1:
✔️Learners who achieve A1 level:

can understand and use very common everyday expressions and simple phrases for immediate needs

,can introduce themselves and other people and can ask and answer questions about personal details, such as where they live, things they have and people they know

can communicate in a simple way if the other person talks slowly and clearly.
profile_a2: ✔️Learners who achieve A2 level: can understand sentences and common expressions about familiar topics, including very basic personal and family information, shopping, places of interest and work, can communicate in simple, everyday tasks that require only simple and direct exchanges of information on familiar topics, can describe aspects of their past, environment and matters related to their immediate needs, using simple language
profile_b1: ✔️Learners who achieve B1 level: can understand the main points of clear texts in standard language if they are about topics with which they are familiar, whether in work, study or leisure contexts, can cope with most of the situations that might arise on a trip to areas where the language is used, can produce simple, coherent texts about topics with which they are familiar or in which they have a personal interest, can describe experiences, events, wishes and aspirations, as well as briefly justifying opinions or explaining plans.

intro_qui_suisje: Welcome to the Foix Lingua presentation page. Discover my background and passion for languages.
presentation_1:
I studied Spanish Language and Literature at Bordeaux III, Madrid and Seville Universities. I went on to pass the CAPES (Certificate of aptitude for secondary school teachers) and spent several years teaching Spanish in Lille and Paris before settling permanently in the Ariège in 2004. I was also a deputy head at local secondary schools. 

 What has been my career motivation? Intellectual curiosity, a love of meeting people and communication. I have always been passionate about languages and different cultures, which I continue to nurture by travelling regularly, getting involved in local community associations, reading, and more. 

 How did the FOIX LINGUA project begin? When I was teaching French as a Foreign Language as a volunteer, I started receiving requests for private lessons. Then came the meeting with Corine de Valorme, who was ready to hand over the reins. I began to research French language teaching methods: obtaining a MOOC (massive open online course) at Liège University, exploring specialised websites and finally preparing my own teaching programmes. 

 So now with great enthusiasm I’m delighted to put my energy and skills into helping you feel at home in the French language and to discover the wonderful welcoming Ariège.
